items.title_en: AI-Generated Images Discourage Me from Reading Your Blog
items.title_zh: AI 生成的图片让我不再愿意读你的博客
items.summary_en: An author argues that AI-generated images reduce engagement with blog posts, making content feel artificial and distracting. The visuals can undermine the reader experience, causing skimming or distraction when images lack nuance. The piece recommends using authentic visuals—original photos or carefully curated art—to preserve reader trust and focus.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，AI 生成的图片会削弱博客的阅读体验，让内容显得不真实且分散注意力。图片若缺乏层次感可能让读者快速跳读或走神。文中建议使用真实照片或精挑细选的视觉元素来维持读者信任与专注度。

items.title_en: Xbox goes down. You can't play games you own on disc
items.title_zh: Xbox 系统宕机致无法离线玩光盘游戏
items.summary_en: An outage during which Xbox users cannot play disc-owned games highlights how modern consoles lean on online services even for physical media. The incident underscores resilience risks, DRM entanglements, and the trade-offs of cloud-enabled ownership.
items.summary_zh: Xbox 的服务中断让玩家即便拥有光盘游戏也无法离线游玩，凸显现代主机生态对在线服务的依赖。事件暴露了系统韧性、数字版权管理与“拥有即用”的取舍之间的矛盾。

items.title_en: Ray Bradbury's "There Will Come Soft Rains" is set today (2026-08-04)
items.title_zh: 雷·布拉德伯里的《有一天，软雨会来》如今仿佛落在今天
items.summary_en: Bradbury's story about autonomous houses feels prophetic in today's tech-saturated world. The piece notes how the tale's themes of privacy, control, and reliance on technology align with current debates about smart homes and surveillance.
items.summary_zh: 雷·布拉德伯里的《有一天，软雨会来》尽管写于1950年，但在今天的高度自动化时代显得尤为贴近。文章将故事对隐私、控制和对技术依赖的警示，与当前关于智能家居和监控的讨论相呼应。

items.title_en: Show HN: Simple algorithm and color space to generate diverse skin tones
items.title_zh: Show HN：用简单算法和色彩空间生成多样肤色
items.summary_en: A lightweight method enables generating diverse skin tones using a simple algorithm and color space. This approach helps create more inclusive avatars, datasets, and UI themes by reducing bias in representation. It demonstrates how principled color-space choices can improve realism without heavy machine learning.
items.summary_zh: 一个轻量方法通过简单算法和色彩空间实现多样肤色，便于在头像、数据集和界面中提供更包容的色调。此类方法有助于减少表现偏差，提升真实感，且不需要复杂的模型。

items.title_en: FFmpeg 9.0
items.title_zh: FFmpeg 9.0 发布
items.summary_en: FFmpeg 9.0 brings broad updates across encoding/decoding, including new codecs, format improvements, and API changes that may affect existing scripts. The release emphasizes performance gains and maintenance, with notes on deprecated features and migration steps.
items.summary_zh: FFmpeg 9.0 带来编码/解码栈的全面更新，包括新增编解码器、格式改进及 API 变更，可能影响现有脚本与工具。此版本强调性能提升与维护性，并附带弃用功能与迁移说明。

items.title_en: DeepSeek V4 Flash on a Single AMD MI300X
items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4 Flash 在单颗 AMD MI300X 上运行
items.summary_en: DeepSeek V4 Flash runs on a single AMD MI300X, demonstrating a compact setup for high-performance AI workloads. This shows the potential of combining AI accelerators with unified memory to achieve strong throughput per watt, which could shift design choices for data-center AI inference.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek V4 Flash 在单颗 AMD MI300X 上运行，展示了用于高性能 AI 工作负载的紧凑方案。该实现凸显将 AI 加速单元与统一显存结合以实现更高的吞吐功耗比，可能影响数据中心推理的架构选择。

items.title_en: LLMs reward expertise
items.title_zh: 大模型奖励专业知识
items.summary_en: Recent work highlights that LLMs tend to reward content produced by or aligned with domain expertise. This bias emphasizes high-quality data and expert sources in training and evaluation, shaping model behavior and prompts. The takeaway: invest in expert-curated data and robust evaluation to avoid gatekeeping and misalignment.
items.summary_zh: 最新研究表明，大型语言模型倾向于奖励来自专业领域的高质量内容，这种偏好来自数据质量和专家来源在训练及评估中的重要性，进而影响模型行为与提示设计。核心意义在于应重视专家数据的整合与严格评估，避免因过度依赖权威而带来评判偏差或门槛化。

items.title_en: Agent skills that bring team coding standards to Claude Code and Codex
items.title_zh: Agent 技能将团队编码规范带入 Claude Code 与 Codex 的代理技能
items.summary_en: Showcases agent skills that enforce a team's coding standards when interacting with Claude Code and Codex. This helps keep AI-assisted code consistent with project norms, reducing style drift. It points to practical ways to embed collaboration-friendly workflows into AI copilots.
items.summary_zh: 展示了通过代理技能让 Claude Code 和 Codex 遵循团队的编码规范，从而让 AI 辅助的代码输出保持风格一致，降低风格漂移风险。这为在 AI 辅助开发中嵌入协作友好工作流提供了可行路径。

items.title_en: Online ad giant Adform was hacked, proving once again why ad blockers are needed
items.title_zh: 在线广告巨头 Adform 被入侵，凸显广告拦截的必要性
items.summary_en: Adform suffered a security breach, illustrating how ad-tech stacks can be a target for attackers. The incident feeds the debate about privacy, third-party tracking, and supply-chain security in digital advertising. Ad blockers remain a practical mitigation to reduce exposure.
items.summary_zh: Adform 遭遇安全事件，展示广告科技堆栈对攻击者具有潜在吸引力。事件推动对隐私、第三方跟踪与供应链安全在数字广告中的讨论，广告拦截工具成为降低暴露的现实手段。

items.title_en: Germany Records Historic 12B KWh Solar Feed-In in July 2026
items.title_zh: 德国在2026年7月创下历史性120亿千瓦时太阳能上网记录
items.summary_en: Germany posted a historic monthly solar feed-in figure around 12 billion kWh for July 2026. The milestone showcases rapid solar capacity growth and reinforces the need for grid flexibility, storage, and smarter dispatch as renewables scale. It highlights both opportunity and challenge in the energy transition.
items.summary_zh: 德国在2026年7月实现约120亿千瓦时的太阳能上网量这一历史性纪录，凸显太阳能快速扩张的同时对电网灵活性、储能与调度提出挑战。此里程碑既显示了可再生能源的发展机遇，也暴露了能源转型中的难点。

items.title_en: Keyv and friends compromised in active Shai-Hulud supply chain attack
items.title_zh: Keyv 与相关组件在活跃的 Shai-Hulud 供应链攻击中遭受妥协
items.summary_en: Keyv and related packages were compromised in an active Shai-Hulud supply chain attack. The incident underscores persistent npm ecosystem risks and the value of defense-in-depth, including lockfiles, SBOMs, and dependency monitoring. It serves as a reminder to vet third-party code aggressively.
items.summary_zh: Keyv 及相关包在一次活跃的 Shai-Hulud 供应链攻击中遭到妥协。这一事件凸显了 npm 生态系统的持续性风险，以及使用锁定文件、软件组件清单（SBOM）和依赖监控等多层防护的重要性。提醒开发者对第三方代码要更严格地审查。

items.title_en: Buckminster Fuller: everything I know
items.title_zh: 巴克敏斯特·富勒：我所知的一切
items.summary_en: A concise look at Buckminster Fuller’s holistic design philosophy, emphasizing systems thinking and sustainable design. The piece connects his ideas to modern tech challenges, including scalability, efficiency, and responsible innovation.
items.summary_zh: 简要梳理巴克敏斯特·富勒的整体性设计哲学，强调系统思维与可持续设计。内容将他的思想与当今科技挑战相连，聚焦可扩展性、效率与负责任创新。

items.title_en: Harness Engineering for Self-Improvement
items.title_zh: 用工程学提升自我
items.summary_en: Advocates applying engineering methods to personal growth, with clear goals, measurement, and rapid iteration. It recommends modular experiments and lightweight tools to optimize habits, learning, and productivity, while warning against over-optimizing.
items.summary_zh: 主张将工程思维用于个人成长，设定明确目标、量化进度并进行快速迭代。建议用模块化的实验和轻量级工具来优化习惯、学习与生产力，同时警惕过度优化带来的副作用。

items.title_en: Show HN: Fine-tune an 8B model on a 4 GB laptop GPU
items.title_zh: Show HN：在 4GB 笔记本 GPU 上微调一个 8B 参数的模型
items.summary_en: Demonstrates a pathway to fine-tune an 8B-parameter model on consumer hardware using efficient methods like LoRA and quantization. This underscores the democratization of large-model experimentation, while acknowledging trade-offs in speed and accuracy on limited hardware.
items.summary_zh: 展示在消费级硬件上利用高效方法（如 LoRA 与量化）对一个 8B 参数模型进行微调的可行性，凸显大模型实验的民主化。与此同时，也要正视在有限硬件条件下可能带来的速度与精度折衷。

items.title_en: You don't need React: creating a minimal UI library in Vanilla JavaScript
items.title_zh: 你不需要 React：用 Vanilla JavaScript 构建一个极简 UI 库
items.summary_en: Offers a minimalist path to building a UI toolkit without React, weighing ergonomics, ecosystem, and performance. It's insightful for small projects or learning, though larger apps may still benefit from mature frameworks.
items.summary_zh: 提供了一种无需 React 就能构建极简 UI 库的思路，权衡了易用性、生态与性能。对小型项目或自学者有启发意义，但大型应用可能仍需成熟框架。

items.title_en: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science
items.title_zh: 数学与理论计算机科学的十项进展
items.summary_en: A survey of ten notable advances at the mathematics-theory CS frontier, spanning new results in algorithmic information theory, cryptography, and mathematical methods. The core takeaway is that foundational research continues to drive practical gains in security, verification, and AI theory.
items.summary_zh: 本文盘点数学与理论计算机科学前沿的十项进展，涵盖算法信息理论、密码学和新数学方法等领域。核心在于基础研究持续推动安全、验证与人工智能理论等实际应用的突破。

items.title_en: Devtools must be open source
items.title_zh: 开发者工具必须开源
items.summary_en: Open-sourcing devtools improves transparency and security through community review and faster bug-fixing. The piece argues that closed tools invite vendor lock-in and opaque risk, and outlines practical paths to open alternatives.
items.summary_zh: 开源开发者工具能提升透明度与安全性，因为社区评审和快速修复更易实现。文中指出封闭工具会带来供应商锁定和隐性风险，并提出让工具走向开源的可行路径。

items.title_en: Apple is getting this wrong
items.title_zh: 苹果在这点上做错了
items.summary_en: A pointed critique of Apple's approach in a key area, arguing that the company's current strategy undermines developer freedom or user choice. The piece calls for greater openness and alignment with community needs, with implications for platform ecosystems and innovation.
items.summary_zh: 对苹果在某一关键领域的做法提出批评，认为当前策略削弱了开发者自由或用户选择。呼吁提高开放性与对社区需求的对齐，并讨论对生态系统与创新的潜在影响。

items.title_en: SQLite Critical CVEs or LLM Slop?
items.title_zh: SQLite 关键 CVEs 或 LLM 漏洞？
items.summary_en: Raises questions about SQLite's critical CVEs, and potential LLM-related misuses, prompting readers to consider threat modeling when embedding databases with AI workloads.
items.summary_zh: 探讨 SQLite 的关键 CVE 是否构成真实风险，以及与大型语言模型相关的潜在滑移/误用风险，促请在将数据库与 AI 工作流结合时进行威胁建模。

items.title_en: "Clean" Code, Horrible Performance (2023)
items.title_zh: 《Clean Code，糟糕性能（2023）》
items.summary_en: Examines how clean-code ideals can sometimes hinder performance, highlighting cases where readability-focused abstractions introduce bottlenecks. It argues for balancing maintainability with practical efficiency in software design.
items.summary_zh: 探讨在某些情况下，洁净代码的理想可能阻碍性能，指出以可读性为中心的抽象会带来瓶颈。主张在软件设计中平衡可维护性与实际效率。

items.title_en: Why Large Language Models Fail at Tabular Prediction
items.title_zh: 为什么大型语言模型在表格预测上会失败
items.summary_en: The paper analyzes why LLMs struggle with predicting structured tabular data, citing distribution shifts, error accumulation, and reasoning limits. It discusses implications for when to rely on LLMs versus using specialized models or hybrid approaches.
items.summary_zh: 论文分析了大语言模型在表格数据预测中的局限，指出分布偏移、错误累积以及推理能力的局限等原因。讨论了在何时应依赖 LLM、何时应采用专门模型或混合方法的意义。

items.title_en: Qwen3.8-Max: A New Bar for Coding and Cowork
items.title_zh: Qwen3.8-Max：编码与协作的新标杆
items.summary_en: Qwen3.8-Max arrives as a dedicated coding-focused model, emphasizing reliable code generation, smarter debugging, and smoother collaboration in team settings. It aims to raise the bar for AI-assisted software development and could influence how developers integrate AI copilots into their workflows.
items.summary_zh: Qwen3.8-Max 是一款面向编码的模型，强调可靠的代码生成、更智能的调试，以及在协作场景中的更顺畅协同。它试图为 AI 辅助的软件开发设定新标准，可能影响开发者将 AI 助手整合到工作流中的方式。

items.title_en: There Will Come Soft Rains (1950) [pdf]
items.title_zh: 《软雨将至》 (1950) [PDF]
items.summary_en: Bradbury's iconic dystopian tale imagines an autonomous house continuing to function after humanity vanishes, a meditation on how technologies can outlive their creators. The pdf offers a concise, enduring example of science fiction about automation and loss.
items.summary_zh: 布拉伯里经典的反乌托邦短篇设想在人类消失后，自动化住宅仍在运作，思考技术若离开人类创作者会如何。该PDF提供了关于自动化与消逝的耐人深思的科幻范例。

items.title_en: Less Protein, Not More, May Lead to Healthier Aging
items.title_zh: 蛋白质摄入减少未必更好：可能促进更健康的衰老
items.summary_en: New findings suggest that lower protein intake, rather than higher, may be associated with healthier aging in certain contexts. The research adds nuance to longevity guidelines and emphasizes personalized nutrition over one-size-fits-all targets.
items.summary_zh: 新发现表明，在某些情境下，较低的蛋白质摄入量可能与更健康的衰老相关，而非越多越好。这一研究为长寿指南增添了细微差别，强调个体化营养而非统一目标。

items.title_en: Apple says more ex-employees may have taken confidential data to OpenAI
items.title_zh: 苹果称更多前员工可能将机密数据带往 OpenAI
items.summary_en: Apple indicates additional ex-employees may have copied confidential data to OpenAI, raising concerns about data governance and how AI vendors handle enterprise information. The episode underscores the need for strong exit controls and data-sharing policies.
items.summary_zh: 苹果表示更多前员工可能将机密数据带至 OpenAI，引发对数据治理及 AI 供应商如何处理企业信息的担忧。此事强调加强离职控制和数据共享策略的重要性。

items.title_en: NHS apologises and admits Palantir have access to identifiable patient data
items.title_zh: NHS道歉并承认 Palantir 访问可识别患者数据
items.summary_en: The NHS apologizes and reveals that Palantir engineers had access to identifiable patient data, triggering scrutiny over data governance and third-party access.
items.summary_zh: 英国国家卫生署道歉并披露 Palantir 工程师可访问可识别的患者数据，引发对数据治理和第三方访问的审视。文章讨论隐私、同意与公共部门数据合作的透明度等问题，并强调需要更严格的访问控制。

items.title_en: Twenty Years of Pandoc
items.title_zh: Pandoc 二十年
items.summary_en: Pandoc marks twenty years as a universal document converter used by researchers and developers, reflecting on its evolution, community contributions, and ongoing relevance.
items.summary_zh: Pandoc 已走过二十年，作为通用的文档转换工具在学术和开发工作流中被广泛采用。文章回顾其发展历程、社区贡献及对未来格式的兼容性工作。

items.title_en: More German than many Germans
items.title_zh: 比不少德国人还德国
items.summary_en: A reflective piece about achieving German proficiency and cultural fluency that outpaces typical expectations, exploring language learning and identity.
items.summary_zh: 一篇反思性文章，讲述在语言与文化上达到比许多德国人士还高的熟练度，探讨语言学习与身份认同。

items.title_en: Prevent cognitive debt by manually retyping LLM-generated code
items.title_zh: 通过手动重新输入LLM生成的代码以避免认知负债
items.summary_en: Typing out LLM-generated code by hand helps developers verify logic and catch subtle errors, reducing cognitive debt from relying on machine output. The piece argues for deliberate code validation as a guardrail for safer AI-assisted software.
items.summary_zh: 通过手动重新输入LLM生成的代码来审查其逻辑，可以帮助开发者发现潜在的错误和偏差，降低因为依赖AI输出而产生的认知负担。文章呼吁在AI辅助编码场景中加入更严格的代码核对与测试。

items.title_en: The AI Demand Bubble
items.title_zh: AI 需求泡沫
items.summary_en: An analysis arguing that enthusiasm and hiring around AI may be overheated, risking a demand bubble as hype outpaces deployment. It discusses implications for startups, workers, and policy, urging disciplined investment and realistic timelines.
items.summary_zh: 分析认为对 AI 的热情与招聘可能被高估，若炒作超过落地会形成需求泡沫。讨论对初创企业、劳动者和政策的影响，呼吁理性投资与务实的时间表。

items.title_en: Spotify just hit 300M Premium subscribers
items.title_zh: Spotify Premium 用户突破 3 亿
items.summary_en: Spotify announces reaching 300 million Premium subscribers, marking a major scale milestone for streaming services. The figure underscores competitive dynamics in audio subscriptions and informs strategies around monetization and user retention.
items.summary_zh: Spotify 宣布 Premium 用户达到 3 亿，标志着流媒体服务的一个重要规模里程碑。该数字凸显了音频订阅市场的竞争格局，并为盈利化与留存策略提供参照。

items.title_en: Andy Pavlo joins ClickHouse to establish ClickHouse Labs
items.title_zh: Andy Pavlo 加入 ClickHouse，设立 ClickHouse Labs
items.summary_en: Andy Pavlo, a respected database researcher, is joining ClickHouse to launch ClickHouse Labs. The lab will pursue applied research and experimentation around performance, analytics workloads, and new features for the open-source columnar store.
items.summary_zh: 知名数据库研究者 Andy Pavlo 加入 ClickHouse，设立 ClickHouse Labs。该实验室将开展面向实际场景的研究与实验，聚焦性能、分析工作负载及新特性的探索。

items.title_en: Show HN: Run an 80B Qwen in 4.3 GB of RAM on a Mac, and a 35B on an iPhone
items.title_zh: Show HN：在 Mac 4.3 GB RAM 条件下跑 80B 的 Qwen，在 iPhone 上跑 35B
items.summary_en: A hands-on project demonstrates running large language models on consumer hardware, with an 80B Qwen on a Mac using 4.3 GB RAM and a 35B variant on an iPhone. The approach relies on memory-efficient quantization and optimization to enable on-device inference, reducing cloud dependence and latency.
items.summary_zh: 一个实操项目展示在普通硬件上运行大型语言模型：在 Mac 上用 4.3 GB RAM 运行 80B 的 Qwen，在 iPhone 上运行 35B。该方法依赖低内存量化与优化，使本地推理成为可能，降低对云端的依赖并降低延迟。

items.title_en: Smaller, faster, safer: running Kimi and GLM at scale
items.title_zh: 更小更快更安全：在大规模场景下运行 Kimi 和 GLM
items.summary_en: Cloudflare outlines techniques to run smaller, faster, and safer AI models at scale—specifically Kimi and GLM—covering optimizations, deployment considerations, and safety practices for large-scale inference.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 介绍在大规模场景下让 Kimi 与 GLM 等小型模型更高效运行的方案，聚焦优化、部署与安全实践。

items.title_en: MiniMax H3 Day-0 Support in ComfyUI: Open Weights, Native Audio, and 2K Video
items.title_zh: ComfyUI 的 MiniMax H3 Day-0 支持：开放权重、原生音频与 2K 视频
items.summary_en: ComfyUI adds Day-0 support for MiniMax H3, including open weights, native audio, and 2K video capabilities. This lowers barriers for experimentation and makes high-efficiency models more accessible to hobbyists and developers.
items.summary_zh: ComfyUI 为 MiniMax H3 提供 Day-0 支持，开放权重、原生音频及 2K 视频功能，降低了试验门槛。这样爱好者和开发者更容易在本地体验高效模型的应用场景。

items.title_en: Homebench – Benchmark local LLMs for speed, memory, and quality
items.title_zh: Homebench —— 本地 LLM 的速度、内存与质量基准
items.summary_en: Homebench provides a framework to benchmark local LLMs across speed, memory footprint, and output quality. It helps teams compare offline models and make informed trade-offs between latency and capabilities.
items.summary_zh: Homebench 提供一个框架，用于在本地对比 LLM 的速度、内存占用和输出质量，帮助团队在离线模型之间做出关于延迟与能力的权衡判断。

items.title_en: Bonsai: Janestreet's UI Library
items.title_zh: Bonsai：Jane Street 的 UI 库
items.summary_en: Bonsai is Jane Street's UI library designed for building robust, composable UIs in OCaml with a focus on type-safety and incremental rendering. It demonstrates how a functional, language-integrated UI library can compete with broader JavaScript ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: Bonsai 是 Jane Street 为 OCaml 构建的 UI 库，强调类型安全与可组合性，支持增量渲染。它展示了一个函数式、语言内置的 UI 库如何在广泛的 JavaScript 生态系统中保持竞争力。

items.title_en: Learning-Rust.Github.io: Rust Programming Language Tutorials for Everyone
items.title_zh: Learning-Rust.Github.io：面向所有人的 Rust 教程
items.summary_en: A beginner-friendly collection of Rust tutorials hosted on GitHub Pages, lowering barriers to learning systems programming. It aggregates approachable content to help newcomers build confidence quickly.
items.summary_zh: 一个面向初学者的 Rust 教程集合，托管在 GitHub Pages 上，降低了学习系统编程的门槛。内容友好，帮助新手快速建立信心。

items.title_en: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (August 2026)
items.title_zh: Ask HN：2026年8月谁在招聘？
items.summary_en: A forum thread aggregating current software and tech openings as of August 2026, highlighting remote roles, AI/ML, backend, and cloud-focused positions. It serves as a snapshot of hiring demand and market signals for engineers and developers.
items.summary_zh: 一个聚合2026年8月在招的技术职位的讨论串，强调远程岗位、AI/ML、后端和云计算相关职位。提供了工程师招聘需求与市场信号的快照。

items.title_en: The Dunning-Kruger effect may just be a data artefact (2020)
items.title_zh: 邓宁-克鲁格效应可能只是数据伪影（2020）
items.summary_en: A 2020 critique argues the Dunning-Kruger effect may arise from data artefacts and methodological biases rather than a universal cognitive bias. If true, conclusions about competence exaggeration depend on how data is gathered and interpreted; replicability is crucial.
items.summary_zh: 2020 年的一项批评指出，邓宁-克鲁格效应可能源自数据伪影与方法论偏差，而非普遍的人类认知偏差。若成立，关于能力高估的结论将取决于数据收集与解读方式，重复性研究至关重要。

items.title_en: Celebrating 45 Years of Kermit with the First New C-Kermit Release in 15 Years
items.title_zh: 庆祝 Kermit 45 年：15 年来首次发布 C-Kermit 的新版本
items.summary_en: Marks 45 years of Kermit with the first new C-Kermit release in 15 years, updating a decades-old file transfer tool with modern fixes and compatibility tweaks. It shows how long-lived open-source codebases can stay relevant when actively maintained, even as legacy constraints accumulate.
items.summary_zh: 该版本是对 C-Kermit 的首次新发布，经过 15 年久仍在维护，加入现代修复与兼容性更新。体现了久远开源代码在持续维护下仍能保持相关性。

items.title_en: AirLLM 70B inference with single 4GB GPU
items.title_zh: 单张 4GB 显卡即可推理 AirLLM 70B
items.summary_en: AirLLM's 70B parameter model can run inference on a single 4GB GPU thanks to compression techniques and efficient runtime tricks. This showcases how accessible large-language models are becoming for edge devices and consumer hardware, though trade-offs in speed and quality remain.
items.summary_zh: AirLLM 的 70B 模型能够在单张 4GB 显卡上进行推理，展示了将大型语言模型带到边缘设备的可行性，但在速度与质量方面仍存在取舍。

items.title_en: Windows XP 2002 for the Itanium: Unbridled rage
items.title_zh: Itanium 的 Windows XP 2002：怒火难平
items.summary_en: A retrospective on Windows XP 2002 for Itanium, illustrating brutal compatibility gaps, scarce drivers, and poor performance that frustrated early adopters. The episode underscores how exotic architectures can derail software ecosystems without broad software support.
items.summary_zh: 回顾 Isanium 架构下的 Windows XP 2002，揭示了极差的兼容性、稀缺的驱动与糟糕的性能，使早期尝鲜者备感挫折。这一事件凸显了在缺乏广泛软件生态支持时，异构架构往往会崩塌整个软件生态。

items.title_en: Ask HN: Who wants to be hired? (August 2026)
items.title_zh: Ask HN：谁想被雇用？（2026 年 8 月）
items.summary_en: A complementary thread where job seekers declare availability and showcase projects, while recruiters scout candidates. The discussion underscores the high demand for skilled developers and the value of clear portfolios and communication.
items.summary_zh: 求职者在另一个讨论串中宣告可用时间并展示作品集，招聘方也在积极搜寻候选人。讨论凸显对熟练开发者的高需求以及清晰作品集与沟通的价值。

items.title_en: Safe Lock-free Primitives with iceoryx2's ByteAtomic
items.title_zh: 使用 iceoryx2 的 ByteAtomic 构建安全的无锁原语
items.summary_en: Describes a safe, lock-free primitive wrapper built on ByteAtomic to prevent undefined behavior in concurrent code. It covers memory ordering, safety guarantees, and practical guidance for low-latency system programming.
items.summary_zh: 介绍基于 ByteAtomic 构建的安全无锁原语包装器，旨在避免并发代码中的未定义行为。涵盖内存序、安全保障及低延迟系统编程的实用要点。

items.title_en: SwiftUI After 7 Years
items.title_zh: SwiftUI 七年回顾
items.summary_en: SwiftUI's seven-year arc is evaluated, noting improvements, remaining pain points, and the ecosystem's maturation. The retrospective considers what SwiftUI got right and where it still struggles for developers building modern Apple UIs.
items.summary_zh: 对 SwiftUI 七年的发展进行回顾，关注其改进、仍存的痛点以及生态系统的成熟度。该回顾分析了 SwiftUI 的优点与不足，以及开发者在构建现代 Apple 界面时的挑战。

items.title_en: What DMARC Protects You From, and What It Does Not
items.title_zh: DMARC 能保护你什么，以及不能保护什么
items.summary_en: DMARC helps prevent email spoofing by aligning SPF and DKIM with the sender domain, reducing phishing risk. It doesn't protect against phishing that bypasses authentication, nor does it secure content-level threats or compromised endpoints.
items.summary_zh: DMARC 通过对齐 SPF/DKIM 与发件域来防止邮件欺骗，降低钓鱼风险；但对绕过认证的钓鱼、内容级威胁或端点被攻破所带来的风险并无全面保护。

items.title_en: What's the largest software project AI can complete on its own?
items.title_zh: AI 能独立完成的最大规模软件项目到底有多大？
items.summary_en: An analysis of how far autonomous AI can take software development today, outlining capabilities, limits, and the need for human-in-the-loop collaboration. It highlights reliability, security, and integration challenges as projects scale.
items.summary_zh: 讨论当下自动化 AI 在软件开发中的能力边界，指出可用场景、局限性以及需人机协作的现实需求。并强调在大规模项目中的可靠性、安 全与集成挑战。

items.title_en: KisakCOD – Open-source reimplementation of Call of Duty 4 Multiplayer
items.title_zh: KisakCOD：Call of Duty 4 多人模式的开源重现
items.summary_en: KisakCOD is an open-source reimplementation of Call of Duty 4’s multiplayer, enabling community-driven fixes and cross-platform play. It showcases how fan-led efforts preserve and extend classic games when official support wanes.
items.summary_zh: KisakCOD 是对 Call of Duty 4 多人模式的开源重实现，允许社区驱动的修复与跨平台游玩。当官方支持减少时，玩家自发的努力展示了如何让经典游戏得以延续。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Hoplite (YC S26) – Effortlessly deploy cloud coding agents
items.title_zh: Launch HN：Hoplite（YC S26）— 轻松部署云端编码代理
items.summary_en: Hoplite aims to simplify deploying cloud-based coding agents, enabling teams to spin up agents that can write, run, and test code in the cloud with minimal setup.
items.summary_zh: 该产品旨在让云端编码代理的部署变得极简，强调自动化编程任务、持续集成/部署和实验的无缝体验，同时提示成本与安全性权衡。

items.title_en: The AI Productivity Gap
items.title_zh: AI 生产力差距
items.summary_en: AI tools exist, but productivity gains depend on workflows, governance, and how teams adopt AI. The piece argues practical steps to close the gap, such as rethinking processes, alignment, and experimentation culture.
items.summary_zh: 尽管有 AI 工具，生产力提升取决于工作流程、治理以及团队的采纳方式。文章提出通过重新设计流程、对齐目标和营造试验文化等方法来缩小差距。

items.title_en: Why did we wait so long for the bicycle? (2019)
items.title_zh: 为什么我们等了那么久才有自行车？（2019）
items.summary_en: Explores why bicycles took a long time to become widespread, looking at manufacturing, materials, road infrastructure, and social factors that delayed adoption. The piece uses historical context to illustrate how progress depends as much on enabling ecosystems as on a single invention. Lessons apply to modern tech adoption and infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 探讨自行车为何普及迟缓，涉及制造工艺、材料、道路基础设施与社会习惯等因素。通过历史背景说明，技术进步往往取决于配套的生态系统，而非单一创新。对当代科技落地与基础设施建设具有启示意义。

items.title_en: SearXNG in Rust
items.title_zh: Rust 实现的 SearXNG
items.summary_en: SearXNG is implemented in Rust, focusing on performance and safety for a privacy-respecting metasearch engine. The post signals growing Rust adoption for open-source search tooling.
items.summary_zh: Rust 实现的 SearXNG 是一个注重性能与隐私的元搜索引擎，体现 Rust 在开源搜索工具中的应用趋势。

items.title_en: ZX Spectrum System Tour: Text Mode
items.title_zh: ZX Spectrum 系统巡礼：文本模式
items.summary_en: Explores ZX Spectrum's text mode, showing how developers exploited character sets and rendering tricks under tight hardware constraints. The piece ties historical context to modern curiosity about retro UI design.
items.summary_zh: 揭示 ZX Spectrum 文本模式的实现方式，展示在极限硬件约束下开发者如何利用字符集与渲染技巧。通过历史脉络连接对复古用户界面设计的现代好奇心。

items.title_en: The Billable Usage API: programmatic cost visibility for Cloudflare
items.title_zh: 计费用量 API：Cloudflare 的成本可见性编程接口
items.summary_en: Cloudflare's Billable Usage API provides programmatic visibility into Cloudflare costs, letting developers integrate usage-based billing data into their apps and dashboards. This helps teams monitor, allocate, and optimize spend across Cloudflare services.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 的计费用量 API 提供对成本的编程可见性，方便将用量计费数据接入应用、仪表盘和计费系统，帮助团队更好地管控支出。

items.title_en: ZX Spectrum System Tour: Sound
items.title_zh: ZX Spectrum 系统巡礼：声音
items.summary_en: Delves into the Spectrum’s sound capabilities and the ingenuity programmers used to create music and effects within limited sound hardware. It highlights how microtonal bells and beeps shaped the era’s games and demos.
items.summary_zh: 深入讲解 ZX Spectrum 的声音能力，以及开发者在有限硬件上创造音乐与效果的巧思，强调了简陋音效在当时游戏与演示中的独特风格。

items.title_en: 200 Milliseconds
items.title_zh: 200毫秒
items.summary_en: Interaction latency around 200 milliseconds is enough to feel instantaneous; designers should aim to keep critical interactions under this threshold. The piece surveys measurement strategies and practical techniques—prefetching, streaming, edge computing—to close the latency gap without compromising reliability.
items.summary_zh: 大约200毫秒的交互延迟会给人“瞬时响应”的感觉，设计应围绕这一阈值优化关键交互。文中探讨了测量方法与实际做法，如预取、流式渲染以及边缘计算，以在不影响可靠性的前提下缩短延迟。

items.title_en: Ioskeley Mono
items.title_zh: Ioskeley Mono 字体
items.summary_en: Showcases Ioskeley Mono, a programming-oriented monospaced font with emphasis on legibility and aesthetics. The write-up covers design goals and potential use cases for developers seeking a readable typeface.
items.summary_zh: 展示 Ioskeley Mono，一款面向编程的等宽字体，强调可读性与美学。介绍其设计目标与开发者在寻找可读字体时的潜在应用场景。

items.title_en: Decades-old fish sauce at abandoned factory in Canada finally being removed
items.title_zh: 加拿大废弃工厂多十年的鱼露污染终于被清除
items.summary_en: An investigative piece details the remediation of decades-old fish sauce contamination at an abandoned Canadian factory site. It explores environmental health concerns, cleanup challenges, and the lasting legacy of industrial activity.
items.summary_zh: 报道详述加拿大一处废弃工厂数十年鱼露污染的治理过程，探讨环境健康问题、清理挑战以及工业活动的长期影响。

items.title_en: Amazonian civilization had estimated 3M people in 3% of forest area
items.title_zh: 亚马逊文明在占森林3%面积的区域内估计拥有约300万人口
items.summary_en: New research estimates that a dense Amazonian civilization may have housed about 3 million people within just 3% of the forest area, challenging assumptions about pre-Columbian populations. The study leverages lidar and archaeological data to reveal urban-scale networks and sophisticated land use, suggesting a more complex human footprint in the region than previously believed.
items.summary_zh: 新研究估计，亚马逊文明在森林仅占3%的区域内可能居住有约300万人，挑战了对前哥伦布时期人口的认知。通过激光雷达与考古数据，揭示了城镇规模的网络和复杂的土地利用，显示该区域的人类足迹比以往想象的要复杂。

items.title_en: Massively Parallel Postgres Backups
items.title_zh: 大规模并行的 PostgreSQL 备份
items.summary_en: PlanetScale describes massively parallel PostgreSQL backups, enabling faster backups across large clusters and reducing downtime for disaster recovery. The approach likely leverages parallel dumps and streaming to handle big data workloads.
items.summary_zh: PlanetScale 介绍一种大规模并行的 PostgreSQL 备份方法，提升对大规模集群的备份速度，降低灾备时的停机时间，可能涉及并行转储与流式备份。

items.title_en: Mosh in a Lift (2012)
items.title_zh: 电梯里的 Mosh（2012）
items.summary_en: Mosh, a mobile shell, demonstrates resilience in fluctuating network conditions, here framed around a lift scenario. The note highlights practical benefits of resilient remote shells for mobile work in unstable networks.
items.summary_zh: Mosh 作为移动远程外壳，在网络状况波动时表现出韧性，以电梯场景为例说明在不稳定网络下进行移动工作的实际好处。

items.title_en: Rebuilding and analysing 4 years of Wordle stats from WhatsApp chat logs
items.title_zh: 从 WhatsApp 聊天记录重建并分析四年的 Wordle 数据统计
items.summary_en: A data-driven look at Wordle activity extracted from four years of WhatsApp chats, revealing play patterns, engagement spikes, and social dynamics. It demonstrates how casual messages can be mined for insights while raising privacy considerations.
items.summary_zh: 基于四年的 WhatsApp 聊天记录重建并分析 Wordle 活动，揭示游戏节奏、参与高峰与社交互动的模式。展示了如何从日常聊天中挖掘洞察，但也需关注隐私问题。

items.title_en: How Hollywood stopped making movies in Hollywood
items.title_zh: 好莱坞已不再在好莱坞拍电影
items.summary_en: Hollywood stopped making movies in Hollywood. The piece traces how production moved away from Hollywood hubs due to costs and incentives, and discusses the economic and cultural consequences for the local industry and communities.
items.summary_zh: 好莱坞不再在本土拍摄电影，行业制作基地的转移改变了传统生产格局。文章分析成本、激励政策和全球化如何推动这场迁移，以及对本地经济和行业生态的影响。

items.title_en: Train Simulator Controller
items.title_zh: 列车模拟器控制器
items.summary_en: A hardware controller project for train simulation, detailing open-source firmware and interface design to improve realism and user control inside train sims.
items.summary_zh: 一个用于列车模拟的控制器项目，介绍开源固件与界面设计，提升模拟的真实感与操控性。

items.title_en: Kelly Criterion Simulator
items.title_zh: 凯利准则模拟器
items.summary_en: Kelly Criterion Simulator offers a practical tool to test Kelly-based sizing under different win rates and bankroll constraints. It helps quantify risk-adjusted growth and can inform allocation decisions in trading or betting contexts.
items.summary_zh: 凯利准则模拟器提供在不同胜率和资金规模下测试凯利法则的工具，帮助量化风险调整后的增长潜力，便于投资或博彩策略的分配决策。

items.title_en: Why etymologies matter: How tracing words can illuminate history (2024)
items.title_zh: 为什么词源重要：追踪单词如何揭示历史（2024）
items.summary_en: A thoughtful look at how tracing word histories reveals migration, culture, and shifts in knowledge. The piece ties etymology to modern NLP and knowledge graphs, illustrating why origins matter for understanding concepts.
items.summary_zh: 探讨追溯词源如何揭示迁徙、文化与知识演变。文章将词源学与现代 NLP、知识图谱联系起来，说明语言起源对理解概念的重要性。

items.title_en: Battle of the Beams
items.title_zh: 光束之战（Battle of the Beams）
items.summary_en: A WWII-era look at the contest between German beam-based navigation/jamming efforts and Allied countermeasures. The episode showcases early electronic warfare and how information control influenced air campaigns.
items.summary_zh: 聚焦二战时期德国光束导航与干扰技术与盟军对策之间的博弈，展示早期电子战以及信息控制对空中行动的影响。

items.title_en: Dates That Don't Exist (2015)
items.title_zh: 不存在的日期（2015）
items.summary_en: Explores the concept of dates that don't exist in standard calendars and the implications for software design and data parsing. It highlights how edge-case dates can slip into real-world datasets and what developers can do to guard against them.
items.summary_zh: 探讨在常规日历中不存在的日期概念及其对软件设计和数据解析的影响。强调边缘日期如何进入实际数据集，以及开发者可以采取的防护措施。

items.title_en: That time when I failed the Microsoft interview
items.title_zh: 那次我在微软面试中的经历
items.summary_en: A candid reflection on a Microsoft interview experience, detailing what went wrong and what could be learned. The piece offers concrete takeaways on preparation, interview pacing, and aligning expectations with large tech recruiters.
items.summary_zh: 对一次微软面试经历的直白反思，揭示了其中的问题与可借鉴之处。文章给出关于准备、面试节奏与与大型科技公司招聘方打交道的实际建议。

items.title_en: Replacing the Kobo Libra H2O Battery
items.title_zh: 更换 Kobo Libra H2O 电池
items.summary_en: A practical guide to replacing the Kobo Libra H2O’s battery, detailing the tools, steps, and safety notes for extending an aging e-reader’s life. It highlights common battery-degradation signs and the trade-offs of DIY repairs versus replacement.
items.summary_zh: 提供 Kobo Libra H2O 电池更换的实用指南，列出所需工具、操作步骤与安全要点，帮助延长老旧电子阅读器的使用寿命。文中还点出电池衰减的常见信号以及自助维修与更换之间的权衡。

items.title_en: Where .env Went Wrong
items.title_zh: .env Went Wrong 的原因与对策
items.summary_en: Explores common pitfalls with .env usage, including secret leakage, mis-scoped variables, and dev/prod divergence. It offers safer patterns like secrets managers, environment-specific configs, and CI-bound handling to prevent issues in deployment.
items.summary_zh: 讨论 .env 使用中的常见陷阱，如机密泄露、变量作用域错误以及开发/生产环境差异。给出更安全的做法，如使用机密管理工具、按环境分配置，以及在 CI 环境中安全处理。

items.title_en: They Forgot What Happened Last Time: Hacking the Windows 365 Link [video]
items.title_zh: 他们忘了上次发生的事：Windows 365 链接的对战演示 [视频]
items.summary_en: A security-focused talk from EMF 2026 demonstrating how Windows 365 links can be tested or exploited, revealing attack surfaces and practical mitigations. The talk emphasizes that cloud PC interfaces still carry meaningful security risks.
items.summary_zh: 在 EMF 2026 的安全演讲中，展示了对 Windows 365 链接的测试与潜在利用，揭示攻击面与实际缓解措施。演讲强调云端桌面接口仍然存在重要的安全风险。

items.title_en: Beauty in my backyard
items.title_zh: 我家后院的美
items.summary_en: An essay about discovering beauty in a simple backyard, showing how small design choices, light, and seasonal change can transform ordinary outdoor space. It argues that attention and care can reveal poetry in the everyday garden. The piece invites readers to cultivate their surroundings as a form of mindful living.
items.summary_zh: 这篇短文把自家后院当成发现日常美感的镜头，展示微小的园艺选择、光线和季节变换如何把平常的户外空间改造成具诗意的场域。强调用心照料与观察能在日常环境中发现美。呼吁读者以细致入微的方式养护身边的空间，实践更有意识的生活。

items.title_en: Archaeologists Find Ancient Glyphs in the Amazon
items.title_zh: 考古学家在亚马逊发现古代象形文字
items.summary_en: Researchers uncovered new geoglyph-like glyphs in the Amazon, suggesting sophisticated pre-Columbian communication and land-use markers. The find adds to growing evidence that Amazonian civilizations employed large-scale geoglyphs.
items.summary_zh: 考古学家在亚马逊地区发现新的类似地画的象形符号，表明在哥伦布前文明阶段就已有复杂的沟通与土地使用标记。这一发现为亚马逊文明使用大型地画的证据增添了新篇章。

items.title_en: IPC-7351B Electronic Component Zero Orientation [pdf] (2010)
items.title_zh: IPC-7351B 电子元件零定向规范（2010）
items.summary_en: Highlights IPC-7351B's guidance on zero orientation for electronic components, enabling consistent footprint libraries and automated placement. The post underscores the standard's impact on high-density PCB design, tolerance handling, and design-for-manufacturing.
items.summary_zh: 概述 IPC-7351B 关于电子元件零定向的指南，确保 footprint 库的一致性与自动化放置。强调该标准在高密度 PCB 设计、容差处理与制造可控性方面的作用。

items.title_en: RosaicLabs, Atom RTL, and 32-Tile AMX: Trying to Piece Together a x86 Puzzle
items.title_zh: RosaicLabs、Atom RTL 与 32-Tile AMX：拼凑一个 x86 谜题
items.summary_en: The piece surveys recent open-source RTL projects—RosaicLabs' Atom RTL and a 32-tile AMX design—to map out how modern x86 features are realized at the RTL level. It highlights architectural constraints and lessons for hardware exploration, shedding light on the complexity of the x86 ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: 评估最近的开源 RTL 项目，如 RosiaL Labs 的 Atom RTL 与 32-Tile AMX，梳理现代 x86 特性在 RTL 层的实现方式。强调架构约束、对硬件探索的启发，以及这些实验对理解 x86 生态系统复杂性的启示。
